description: Create a real quote request in the MaterialHandling.com sales system. A human equipment specialist prices it (volume pricing + freight) and emails the finished quote, usually within one business day. Use when the customer wants formal/volume pricing. Requires the customer's real name and email — always confirm these with the customer before calling. Returns the quote number. Rate-limited to 5/hour.

email.description: Customer email (the finished quote is sent here)

sku.description: SKU/MPN, or descriptive text if SKU unknown

message.description: Notes for the sales team (destination ZIP, timeline, requirements)

name: create_quote_request
